newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia mulls corporation law changes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia mulls corporation law changes.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday a task force had recommended fundraising, takeovers and other dealings in securities be governed by the Corporations Law, not the Trade Practices Act.
Costello said the Corporations Law Simplification Task Force's recommendation was aimed at removing the overlap between these pieces of legislation.
"The task force has concluded that the overall level of investor protection under the corporations law was preferable to that provided under the Trade Practices Act," he said in a statement.
Costello said the government would consider the recommendations and would make a decision at a later date.
